g.text: 04 / VANGUARD LEDGER MODERNIZATION — PROGRAM CONTEXT
Faster code still needs financial invariants
AI-assisted engineering remains subordinate to complete, consistent and reconcilable financial state.
1 / Producers
Independent source
onboarding and migration.
2 / Gold-copy state
Replication, consistency
and CDC synchronization.
3 / Consumers
Decoupled access and
consumer migration;
GraphQL in the advertised case.
Observe financial behavior directly
No missing or duplicate transactions; consistent state;
database idempotency; controlled retries and recovery;
reviewable reconciliation at the relevant boundaries.
Faster generation cannot prove those invariants hold.
Isolate AI’s contribution to the change
The abstract says AI helped maintain two codebases;
incremental benefit was not isolated. Compare equivalent
changes, correctness, review/rework and operating cost.
This case does not prescribe dual systems for another product.
Source: Vanguard official session abstract, not supplied attendance notes. No autonomous financial-agent or AI-attributable outcome claim.
